script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# 把 etbn-mod 工具相关文件从 GitHub raw 同步到 VPS（绕过整站 base64 脚本体积限制）
set -u
BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/main"
D="/var/www/xinmo-site"
sudo mkdir -p "$D/tools/etbn-mod"
OK=0; FAIL=0
for f in \
  "tools/etbn-mod/index.html" \
  "tools/etbn-mod/ETBNightmareMod_FullCopy.zip" \
  "tools/etbn-mod/AI_INSTALL_GUIDE.md" \
  "tools/etbn-mod/INSTALL_README.txt" \
  "assets/js/resources.js"; do
  if sudo curl -fsSL "$BASE/$f" -o "$D/$f"; then
    echo "OK   $f"
    OK=$((OK + 1))
  else
    echo "FAIL $f"
    FAIL=$((FAIL + 1))
  fi
done
sudo chown -R www-data:www-data "$D/tools/etbn-mod" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "--- 结果 OK=$OK FAIL=$FAIL ---"
ls -l "$D/tools/etbn-mod"
echo "resources.js 含 etbn-mod 行数:"
grep -c "etbn-mod" "$D/assets/js/resources.js" || true
